name: Trauma shatter
doc: Trauma's body shattering (enemy attack 291, c0m109, on itself): layout A and a flipbook under it, layouts B and C on the ground, its colour blended to black while the module draws it with 28 pose entries that 20 bone scripts move, turn, bounce and shatter: its bone groups' polygons fly off as fragments (small meshes with their texture) spinning, falling, bouncing and fading, with a mark where each started; bone layouts, rising sprites, the sound and its voice; no damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag290_trauma_shatter.cpp) run on the program's memory (its master's pose, fragments and marks in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

parts.title: Bone scripts
parts.doc: The 20 bone scripts: each moves one of the caster's 28 pose entries (offsets, turns, their speeds, a bounce on the ground), shatters bone groups into fragments (bones, count, speed, size, chance), spawns a bone layout, loops
